dedupe_keys.name: hipe high resolution industrial production energy data set smart meters of ten machines in a power electronics plant kit

description: Smart meter readings from an electronics production plant. The Zenodo record says HIPE holds readings of ten machines and the main terminal of a power-electronics production plant over three months, and that the accompanying ACM paper describes the data, the characteristics of industrial machines compared with household appliances, and open challenges and use cases for industrial energy data. Version 1.0.1, dated 1 May 2019, has two downloadable ZIP files: the cleaned data from 1 October 2017 to 1 January 2018 (about 1.33 GB) and a one-week subset from 23 to 30 October 2017 (about 109 MB), free under CC BY 4.0, with a description page at KIT. Coverage is one plant at KIT in Germany. Caveats: three months only, and the sampling interval is given in the paper, not the record read. For simulation it gives machine-level load profiles for industrial demand response and outage impact models. Related catalogue records include the SPARK dataset from the same group.
